name: Inran na Hitozuma ga Atsumaru Yoga Kyoushitsu
original_name: 淫乱な人妻が集まるヨガ教室
source:
Your cousin asked you to fill in as a yoga instructor. You expected a bunch of older ladies… but instead, you walk into a room full of smoking-hot young wives! Supple, flexible bodies twisting into filthy poses… warm breaths on your skin… eyes burning with need… With every lesson, the tension cranks higher until yoga class becomes a whole new kind of physical education. Meet the gentle-yet-daring Yunagi, the playful and shameless Ran, and Kyoko, the gorgeous instructor. Each one has her own way of wrapping herself around you... and once she's got you, she's not letting go. On the yoga mat, you'll bend them, stretch them, and make them moan until they can't take any more.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3939610/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
你的表弟让你担任瑜伽教练。你以为会有一群年长的女士……但相反，你走进了一个满是性感火辣的年轻妻子的房间！柔软、灵活的身体扭曲成肮脏的姿势……温暖的呼吸拂过你的皮肤……眼睛因需求而燃烧……每节课，紧张感都会加剧，直到瑜伽课成为一种全新的体育课。遇见温柔而大胆的由凪、顽皮而无耻的兰，以及华丽的教练杏子。每个人都有自己包围你的方式……一旦她抓住了你，她就不会放手。在瑜伽垫上，你会弯曲他们、伸展他们，让他们呻吟，直到他们再也受不了为止。
